messages:
Riley Park: Quick sync 1 Velvet Systems wants to run a 6-seat preview next month. Top priorities: SSO + SCIM, data residency assurances, and a low-friction telemetry hook.
Kai (Velvet Systems): Hi all 1 confirmed 6 seats (3 PMs + 3 analysts). Need kickoff Tue afternoon. Also need a short privacy addendum for logs.
Riley Park: @Sam can you take ownership of SSO/SCIM + the privacy addendum? We should pre-fill the legal team template.
Sam Cho: Happy to. I'll draft the addendum and propose SAML + SCIM mapping. Will also note retention policy: 30 days by default for pilot logs unless customer requests redaction.
Ellen Wu: I'll own enablement and adoption. Suggested kickoff: 30m goals + 60m hands-on. We'll include a cost walkthrough and a short prompt-library workshop.
onboard-bot: Pilot intake created 1 docs: Riley Park, infra: Sam Cho, enablement: Ellen Wu, legal: intake-team.
Sam Cho: Telemetry plan: ask them to POST events with tag `velvet_preview`. Minimal payload below:
```
POST https://telemetry.redwood.ai/v1/events
Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "customer":"velvet","user_id":"u_789","seat":"s_01","model":"redwood-latency-opt","tokens":140,"lat_ms":95
}
```
Sam Cho: We'll provide a redaction checklist: remove PII, redact long documents, and salt prompt hashes. I'll attach that to the addendum.
Riley Park: Renewal risk note: they said they'd re-evaluate after 14 days. If active_seats < 3 or avg_daily_tokens < 500, flag for escalation.
Ellen Wu: Adoption cadence: Day 1 kickoff + quick wins, Day 4 troubleshooting session, Day 10 power-user interview, Day 13 renewal prep. I'll prepare one-pagers and nudge templates.
Kai (Velvet Systems): Can you also show a simple cost projection? We want estimated monthly run-rate if usage scales to 2k tokens/day per user.
Sam Cho: I'll add a cost panel with cost_per_1k_tokens and projected monthly burn options (baseline, 2x, 5x). CSV export available.
Ellen Wu: Action items: Sam 1 addendum + telemetry doc by Fri EOD. Ellen 1 enablement deck + nudges by Mon. Riley 1 send calendar invite for Tue 3pm PT and attach success metrics.
Kai (Velvet Systems): Thanks everyone 1 we'll prep internal attendees and send SAML metadata before EOD Thu.
Riley Park: Saving this thread as the source of truth for Velvet preview intake. Will update with links to dashboard and addendum. :pushpin:
